title: AgriVisionSampleMetadata
description: Standard schema for individual image samples across AgriVision AI training datasets and field registries

sample_id.description: Unique immutable identifier for this image sample (e.g., SAM-2026-YE-00194)

crop_id.description: Canonical crop identifier matching supported_crops.json (e.g. crop-tomato, crop-potato)

disease_id.description: Canonical disease identifier matching diseases_catalog.json, or null if healthy

pest_id.description: Canonical pest identifier matching pests_catalog.json, or null if no pest infestation

image_path.description: Relative storage path or S3 key to the original high-resolution image file

capture_date.description: Date of field capture in YYYY-MM-DD format

governorate_id.description: Yemeni governorate ID matching yemen_governorates.json (e.g. ye-sa, ye-dh)

district_id.description: Sub-governorate administrative district or wadi name

farm_id.description: Associated anonymized farm UUID if collected from a registered farm

growth_stage.description: Growth stage at time of observation (e.g. seedling, vegetative, flowering, fruiting, harvest)

annotation_status.description: Quality assurance and verification state of ground-truth labels

annotator_id.description: Identifier or UUID of the researcher or annotator who labeled the image

reviewer_id.description: Identifier or UUID of the senior agronomist who validated the annotation

source.description: Origin of the sample (e.g. yemen_field_survey_2026, plantvillage, plantdoc, academic_partner)

license.description: Open source or proprietary data usage license terms (e.g. CC-BY-4.0)

dataset_version.description: Semantic release version of the dataset release (e.g. v1.2.0)
